function getSmallestPortraitRatio(items): number | null

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/sizing.ts:318

Calculates the smallest portrait aspect ratio (height / width) among portrait items. Used in mixed carousels to anchor the uniform carousel height on mobile to the shortest portrait item.

Parameters

items

CarouselItem[]

List of slide descriptors.

Returns

number | null

Smallest portrait height-to-width ratio, or null if no portrait items with sizes.
